data.scan_local_networks: Scan local networks for Direct Connect hosts (Beta)

data_description.scan_local_networks: Scan local networks to communicate directly with the FranklinWH gateway.  Alternately, if you have another method to determine a gateway's IPv4 address enter it below.  This may improve performance and reliability, but is currently in beta and may not work in all environments.  NOTE: large networks may require several minutes to scan.  WARNING: this process is prohibited in some environments.
